---
title: "National Inpatient Sample Study"
params:
  data_path: null
  years: [2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022]
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(srvyr)
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)

gtsummary::theme_gtsummary_journal("jama")

is_example <- is.null(params$data_path)
input_path <- if (is_example) {
  nis_example(years = params$years)
} else {
  params$data_path
}

nis_data <- nis_open(input_path, years = params$years) |>
  nis_flag_dx(diagnosis_flag = c("I", "J", "E")) |>
  nis_flag_pr(procedure_flag = "0")

study_design <- if (is_example) {
  nis_design(
    nis_data,
    AGE >= 65,
    keep = c(YEAR, HOSP_NIS, NIS_STRATUM, DISCWT, AGE, FEMALE, DIED, ELECTIVE,
             LOS, TOTCHG, CCR_NIS, diagnosis_flag, procedure_flag),
    annualize = FALSE,
    dollars = 2022
  )
}
```

## Methods

This workflow covers ICD-10 NIS years `r paste(params$years, collapse = ", ")`.
In the invented example, the survey design uses year-specific hospital
clusters, NIS strata, and `DISCWT` discharge weights. Diagnosis and procedure
flags are added to the whole lazy dataset before nis_design() selects the age
65 or older cohort as part of design construction. The design uses annual
discharge weights without annualization. nis_design() applies nis_label() and
nis_cost() to the retained cohort, adjusting cost and charges using CPI-U to
2022 USD when TOTCHG and CCR_NIS are retained.

The survey design and cost workflow are experimental and have not been
scientifically validated or approved for publication. This template does not
imply HCUP endorsement.

The report uses easyNIS `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("easyNIS"))`,
R `r getRversion()`, survey
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("survey"))`, srvyr
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("srvyr"))`, dplyr
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("dplyr"))`, and gtsummary
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("gtsummary"))`.

When data_path is null, every record comes from the entirely invented
nis_example() fixture. To use locally prepared data, change only data_path in
this file to that directory and keep the selected years current. For local data,
analysis tables, flow counts, trends, and model output are omitted until a
disclosure review protects small cells and complementary counts across the
complete report. No record-derived results are emitted in local-data mode.

## Cohort flow

These lazy dplyr summarise() steps count all discharges, those age 65 or older,
those in that age group with the example diagnosis flag, and those with both
example flags. This flow is shown only for the invented fixture.

```{r}
if (is_example) {
  flow_all <- nis_data |>
    summarise(n = n(), weighted_discharges = sum(DISCWT)) |>
    mutate(step = "All discharges") |>
    select(step, everything()) |>
    collect()

  flow_age <- nis_data |>
    filter(AGE >= 65) |>
    summarise(n = n(), weighted_discharges = sum(DISCWT)) |>
    mutate(step = "Age 65 or older") |>
    select(step, everything()) |>
    collect()

  flow_diagnosis <- nis_data |>
    filter(AGE >= 65, diagnosis_flag) |>
    summarise(n = n(), weighted_discharges = sum(DISCWT)) |>
    mutate(step = "Age cohort and example diagnosis flag") |>
    select(step, everything()) |>
    collect()

  flow_procedure <- nis_data |>
    filter(AGE >= 65, diagnosis_flag, procedure_flag) |>
    summarise(n = n(), weighted_discharges = sum(DISCWT)) |>
    mutate(step = "Age cohort and both example flags") |>
    select(step, everything()) |>
    collect()

  flow_table <- bind_rows(flow_all, flow_age, flow_diagnosis, flow_procedure)
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    gt::gt(flow_table)
  } else {
    knitr::kable(flow_table)
  }
} else {
  cat("Flow counts are omitted for local data pending complementary suppression.")
}
```

## Table 1

```{r}
if (is_example) {
  table_one <- gtsummary::tbl_svysummary(
    study_design,
    by = FEMALE,
    include = c(AGE, YEAR, LOS, cost_adj)
  ) |>
    gtsummary::add_overall() |>
    nis_suppress(threshold = 10)
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    gtsummary::as_gt(table_one)
  } else {
    gtsummary::as_flex_table(table_one)
  }
} else {
  cat("Table 1 is omitted in local-data mode pending report-wide disclosure review.")
}
```

## Multivariable models

The invented example fits the models and builds gtsummary tables grouped by
model family. Their regression tables are withheld because the current
nis_suppress() contract does not cover regression summaries.

```{r}
if (is_example) {
  # Adjust for differences between pooled study years.
  covariates <- c("AGE", "FEMALE", "factor(YEAR)")

  binary_models <- purrr::map(c("DIED", "ELECTIVE"), function(outcome) {
    survey::svyglm(
      stats::reformulate(covariates, response = outcome),
      design = study_design,
      family = quasibinomial()
    )
  })
  names(binary_models) <- c("DIED", "ELECTIVE")
  binary_tables <- purrr::map(binary_models, function(model) {
    gtsummary::tbl_regression(model, exponentiate = TRUE)
  })
  binary_table <- gtsummary::tbl_merge(
    list_tbls = binary_tables,
    tab_spanner = c("**DIED**", "**ELECTIVE**")
  )

  gaussian_models <- purrr::map(c("LOS", "cost_adj"), function(outcome) {
    survey::svyglm(
      stats::reformulate(covariates, response = outcome),
      design = study_design,
      family = gaussian()
    )
  })
  names(gaussian_models) <- c("LOS", "cost_adj")
  gaussian_tables <- purrr::map(gaussian_models, function(model) {
    gtsummary::tbl_regression(model, exponentiate = FALSE)
  })
  gaussian_table <- gtsummary::tbl_merge(
    list_tbls = gaussian_tables,
    tab_spanner = c("**LOS**", "**Cost**")
  )
  invisible(list(binary = binary_table, gaussian = gaussian_table))
  cat("Model tables are withheld pending disclosure-safe regression suppression.")
} else {
  cat("Model results are omitted in local-data mode pending report-wide disclosure review.")
}
```

## Deferred analyses

Inverse-probability treatment weighting (IPTW) is deferred. The experimental
scaffold does not define a treatment effect or a weighting procedure.
